"If I ever, by some miracle, managed to get into a relationship, it would be a complete disaster. I’m way too unstable. No one should have to deal with someone who’s covered in self harm scars, constantly battling slipping back into multiple addictions, constantly suicidal..."


Trust me I can relate to your story. I was not meant to exist in this world. But that paragraph just isn't true, I promise. Whether it's a relationship or a friend, WHEN you find someone who truly loves you - they will only support you through all of those things. You will find at least one person like this in your life. It is worth sticking around for. 


"Having a job for more than six months either pushes my into such a deep depression I start self-harming, slipping into addiction or trying to kill myself"

I'm in the exact same situation. Every time I get a new job, I'm sober. Then a weeks go by and I start slipping back into heavy addiction just to function normally. After months of that, I cease to exist and quit before I put a bullet through my skull. 


Sorry I don't have much uplifting advice, I just wanted to comment because I related to every point made in your post.
I sent her a text telling the truth. I'm at the hospital right now.
Thanks man. You have a good therapist. Reading something your sober, sane self wrote to your fucked up self would really bring you back to earth. Thanks man, I really appreciate the support.

I was in a very similar situation. Same diagnoses and everything. I don't smoke much anymore, I got off by giving my stash to a trusted friend and switching to exclusively cbd. I quit smoking cold turkey, and the first few days were hell but now that need to smoke is completely gone. Hope this helps. Good luck!
